desc: Parse H, W, X, starting position (P, Q), and the grid of strengths.
Convert to 0-indexed coordinates and store strengths in a 2D list.
Initialize `cur = S[P][Q]`, a `visited` grid, and a max‑heap seeded with the four neighbors of the start cell.
Repeatedly pop the strongest slime from the heap; if `s * X < cur`, absorb it (add to `cur`, mark visited, push its four unvisited neighbors); otherwise break.
Wrap the logic in a `solve()` function and call it under `if __name__ == "__main__":`.
